text:
maya.k: Heads up — I pushed a follow-up to #342 (force-commit tests + logging) and fixed the race on shard allocator. PTAL when you have a sec.

Derek: thanks! quick q — did you keep the public API stable? last PR comment asked to preserve the endpoint signature.

maya.k: yup, didn't touch the endpoint shape. I added a compatibility flag `enable_new_allocator` that defaults to false so callers won't see behavior changes.

Olivia: can you paste the smoke command? want to run it locally.

maya.k: sure:
```
./scripts/run_smoke.sh --profile=local --workers=2
```

maya.k: note — I also added a tiny unit that covers the allocator rotation (tests/allocator/rotation_test.go). CI passes locally for me.

ci-bot: Build #342.5: all checks passed ✅

Derek: pushed a small nit in a comment, left inline. overall looks clean. is this safe to squash, or keep commits for history?

maya.k: I'd prefer to squash to keep the history clean; changelog entry is included in the PR description. If folks want the commit history preserved I can re-open separate branch.

Olivia: I can take a quick run and merge if no objections. Derek, any blocker from your side after the nit?

Derek: nit isn't blocking. lgtm after squash. :thumbsup: 

maya.k: thanks — squashing now. @merge-ops can you schedule a canary slot today after 3pm PT? If there's an autoscale blip we should monitor.

merge-ops: scheduled canary window 2026-03-18 15:30 PT. Will watch metrics.

maya.k: awesome, thanks team. PTAL one last time if you can before I hit merge after the canary.
